signals.name: Credit-to-GDP gap
signals.formula: ratio minus one-sided HP trend, lambda 400,000
signals.rule: green < 2.0 pp, amber to 10.0, red above
signals.cite: Borio & Lowe (2002); Drehmann & Juselius (2014), BIS credit-to-GDP gap early-warning research

signals.name: Red zones
signals.source: FRED QUSNAM770A, QUSHAM770A, CSUSHPINSA; Shiller S&P price
signals.formula: 3y change in credit/GDP and 3y asset price growth, expanding percentiles
signals.rule: red when credit >= 80th pct and prices >= 66.7th pct
signals.cite: Greenwood, Hanson, Shleifer & Sorensen (2022), 'Predictable Financial Crises', Journal of Finance

signals.name: Yield-curve recession odds
signals.formula: probit fitted to Estrella-Mishkin's table on the trailing-quarter average spread
signals.cite: Estrella & Mishkin (1996, 1998), 'The Yield Curve as a Predictor of U.S. Recessions'

signals.name: Excess bond premium
signals.formula: published EBP
signals.cite: Gilchrist & Zakrajsek (2012), 'Credit Spreads and Business Cycle Fluctuations', AER

signals.name: Valuation (CAPE)
signals.formula: CAPE percentile; 10y expected real return from log-CAPE regression
signals.rule: context only, never a timing signal
signals.cite: Campbell & Shiller (1988, 1998); Shiller, Irrational Exuberance

signals.name: Sentiment composite
signals.formula: mean of rolling 5y z-scores, re-standardised
signals.cite: Baker & Wurgler (2006), 'Investor Sentiment and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns', JF

signals.name: Variance risk premium
signals.formula: VIX^2/12 - 21d realised variance
signals.cite: Bollerslev, Tauchen & Zhou (2009), 'Expected Stock Returns and Variance Risk Premia', RFS

signals.name: Bubble watch
signals.formula: 2y return minus SPY 2y return; acceleration, volatility, issuance warnings
signals.cite: Greenwood, Shleifer & You (2019), 'Bubbles for Fama', Journal of Financial Economics

signals.name: Momentum crash guard
signals.formula: 24m market return < 0 and 126d vol >= 80th pct
signals.cite: Daniel & Moskowitz (2016), 'Momentum Crashes', Journal of Financial Economics

signals.name: Market trend
signals.formula: 12m excess return sign and price vs 10-month SMA
signals.cite: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), 'Time Series Momentum', JFE; Faber (2007) 10-month SMA

signals.name: Value
signals.formula: Average within-sector percentile of book equity / market cap and TTM net income / market cap
signals.cite: Fama & French (1992, 1993): book-to-market and earnings yield

signals.name: Momentum
signals.formula: Total return from t-12 to t-1 months
signals.cite: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993): 12-month return skipping the latest month

signals.name: Profitability
signals.formula: Within-sector percentile of TTM gross profit / assets (Novy-Marx), averaged with TTM operating income / assets where available (firms without cost of goods sold use the latter)
signals.cite: Novy-Marx (2013), 'The Other Side of Value': gross profit / assets

signals.name: Investment
signals.formula: Total asset growth over 1 year (lower ranks higher)
signals.cite: Cooper, Gulen & Schill (2008), 'Asset Growth and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns'

signals.name: Issuance
signals.formula: 1-year log change in split-adjusted shares outstanding (lower ranks higher), penalty for listings younger than 5 years
signals.cite: Loughran & Ritter (1995), 'The New Issues Puzzle'; Pontiff & Woodgate (2008)

signals.name: Insiders
signals.formula: Net opportunistic insider buys (count of insiders) over 180 days; routine traders (same calendar month 3 years running) excluded
signals.cite: Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski (2012), 'Decoding Inside Information': opportunistic trades

signals.name: Short Interest
signals.formula: Short shares / shares outstanding (FINRA, twice monthly); lower ranks higher
signals.cite: Boehmer, Huszar & Jordan (2010); Asquith, Pathak & Ritter (2005)

signals.name: Sue
signals.formula: (EPS_q - EPS_q-4) / std of the prior 8 such changes; only within ~95 days of the filing
signals.cite: Bernard & Thomas (1989), post-earnings-announcement drift (SUE)

signals.name: Lowvol
signals.formula: Average within-sector percentile of 1-year daily volatility and 2-year beta (lower ranks higher)
signals.cite: Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), 'Betting Against Beta'; Ang et al. (2006)

signals.name: ETF momentum and trend
signals.formula: 12-1 momentum, trend (12m return and 10m SMA), bubble penalty, risk-adjusted momentum
signals.cite: Moskowitz & Grinblatt (1999) industry momentum; Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012)

signals.name: ETF look-through
signals.formula: holdings-weighted stock score
signals.cite: Holdings-weighted average of this screener's stock scores (SPDR daily holdings files)

signals.name: Event calendar
signals.formula: FOMC, CPI, jobs and earnings dates
signals.cite: Savor & Wilson (2013); Lucca & Moench (2015)

regime_rule: Fragile = (credit gap or a red zone is red) AND Stretched; Stretched = euphoric sentiment or >= 20% of sector/industry ETFs bubble-flagged; otherwise Calm
